en.text: Holding every other figure from the report unchanged and altering only the treatment of emissions accruing to the non-circulating wallet, Q2 2026 net issuance is −412,960 HYPE rather than the +890,000 the report concludes. Removing the 39,792 token-burn line entirely still leaves −373,168.
en.falsifier: Add the four terms: 2,419,166 − 1,311,093 = 1,108,073; + 1,288,967 = 2,397,040; − 2,810,000 = −412,960. Any other result falsifies the arithmetic. en.title: HYPE Q2 2026 net issuance: +890,000 vs −412,960 — receipt
en.og_title: Applying the report's own circulating-supply definition consistently: HYPE Q2 net issuance is −412,960, not +890,000
en.mo_ta: Receipt for a Vietnamese write-up: the numbers, the exact Hyperliquid Info API calls, the falsifiers, and what the measurement does not cover.
en.intro: This is a receipt, not a translation. The full write-up is in Vietnamese; everything needed to verify or refute the claims is here in English: the figures, the exact API calls that produce them, what would falsify each claim, and what the measurement does not cover.
en.pin: No block number anywhere. HyperCore is read through Hyperliquid's Info API; the default public HyperEVM RPC does not serve reliable historical state (same block number twice, 20 s apart, returns two different values; a future block returns a number instead of an error; the official docs state it is "not supported at this time on the default RPC implementation"). Third-party paid endpoints were not tested. Every figure below is a wall-clock snapshot taken 2026-08-07.
how_to_check: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info · {"type":"tokenDetails","tokenId":"<HYPE>"} — read nonCirculatingUserBalances, circulatingSupply, totalSupply. Get tokenId from {"type":"spotMetaAndAssetCtxs"}.
{"type":"delegatorRewards","user":"0x43e9abea1910387c4292bca4b94de81462f8a251"} — sum totalAmount per quarter. Check for gaps: record count, distinct-day count and span length must all be equal.

{"type":"userNonFundingLedgerUpdates","user":"0x43e9abea…","startTime":…,"endTime":…} — scan month by month so the row limit is never hit; match every destination against the non-circulating set above.
{"type":"validatorSummaries"} — sum the stake field, divide by 1e8.
limits: The non-circulating classification is read at measurement time, not per day inside Q2. There is no historical source for that field.
The ~299M float base attributed to the report is an inference from its own subtraction, not a direct snapshot of the exclusion list during Q2.
Input data comes from an API published by Hyperliquid itself. That is one source, not two independent ones. The arithmetic on top of it is checkable.
Only the 2Q2026 report is in hand. The six-quarter series measures inflow to the wallet; it does not show that earlier reports used the same treatment.

The two paths measuring outflow differ by 1 HYPE (1,288,966 from the transfer ledger, 1,288,967 from finalised withdrawals). The difference sits entirely in April and is 0.00008%; the arithmetic uses the second. Using the first gives −412,961.
